```{r}
library(jsonlite)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Phenotype QC checks

## Introduction

This file contains the output for data checks done on harmonized phenotype data. Data importing and stacking happens in `import_data.R`.

## Data checks


```{r}
url.json <- "https://github.com/UW-GAC/primed_data_models/raw/refs/heads/main/PRIMED_phenotype_data_model.json"

df.json <- fromJSON(url.json) 

df.data_type <- df.json$tables %>% 
  mutate(
    columns = purrr::map(
      columns,
      ~ dplyr::select(.x, column, data_type)
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols=columns)
```

### Blood pressure

```{r}
df.blood_pressure <- read.csv("data/out/cmqt_blood_pressure.csv")

df.blood_pressure.data_type <- df.data_type %>% 
  filter(table == "cmqt_blood_pressure")

vars.float <- df.blood_pressure.data_type %>% 
  filter(data_type == "float") %>% 
  pull(column)

vars.enumeration <- df.blood_pressure.data_type %>%
  filter(data_type == "enumeration") %>%
  pull(column)
```

#### Float variables

```{r}
for (col in vars.float){
  p <- df.blood_pressure %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y=.data[[col]], group=file_name)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(title=col) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )
  
  print(p)
}
# todo geom_violin
```

#### Enumeration variables

```{r}
for (col in vars.enumeration){
  p <- df.blood_pressure %>% 
    mutate(
      "{col}" := fct_na_value_to_level(
        factor(.data[[col]]),
        level = "Missing"
      )
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = file_name, fill = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(
      x = "Data Source",
      y = "Proportion",
      fill = col,
      title=col
      ) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
      )

  print(p)
}

```
